[SWS_PHM_01337] Unintended termination of Self-Terminating Pro- cess
⌈
If an Alive Supervision is configured for a Self Terminating Process
and if the process terminates without reporting terminatingCheckpoint and
no SIGTERM was issued to the process by Execution Management, then Plat-
form Health Management shall notify a failure of Alive Supervision to State
Management via ara::phm::RecoveryAction::RecoveryHandler.
⌋
